answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with a random walk capped at \(k\) steps, so distant endorsements cannot amplify without bound. If sybil identities cluster behind a sparse external cut, their low conductance limits walk flow from trusted seeds into the cluster; under bounded edge weights and seed-based voting, min-cut transitivity bounds the cluster’s aggregate voting weight. A harbor, meadow, and ocean may name nodes, but labels alone confer no trust.
